author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists at the University of Pennsylvania have developed a chewing gum that targets cancer-associated microbes in the mouth, including HPV and harmful bacteria linked to head and neck cancers. The gum contains plant-derived lectin and an antimicrobial peptide that dramatically reduce these microbes while sparing beneficial oral flora.

Source Article: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-026-39062-w
